name: individual-social-philosophy
description: Individual Social Philosophy: a comprehensive micro-sociological and ethical framework for navigating interpersonal life. Grounded in biblical wisdom (Sirach, Proverbs, Gospels), Catholic scholasticism (Aquinas, Aelred of Rievaulx), Eastern Orthodox asceticism (nepsis, diakrisis), and Protestant casuistry (Bonhoeffer, Lewis), integrating game-theoretic trust asymmetry and objective social risk calculation.
